why: A number that may be absent (design/absent-number.md). readMechanic: a shorthand field of a local a guard narrowed reads the local's stored Option and unwraps it, and pick's loop requires the captured params present (the guard before the loop proves it); the refactor spells the fields out and turns one guard around (proved). nthOf changes the fallback of an absent nth (WITNESS, not proved). A dictionary read typed number is undefined on a missing key and a prototype function on an Object.prototype name: entryOr's `v === undefined ? 0 : v` through a const binding equals `p[k] ?? 0` (proved); entryKind drops the typeof test the type calls dead (WITNESS, not proved; the base proved it equal). entryLet tests a `let` copy of the read: no single read stands behind it, so the unit is one opaque function keyed by its source (absent_number_<hash>), never equal across a change (lane B PASS-bounded, lane A ASK:unproved). readMechanic returns `Math.round(price * 100)` in its record, which is -0 for price in (-0.005, 0): a -0 an operation makes, so the unit is read opaque (design/signed-zero.md) and not proved (lane A ASK:unproved, the check PASS-bounded).
